title: $X$-ADM Mass and $X$-Positive Mass Theorem
summary: For a given admissible vector field $X$, we define a geometric quantity for asymptotically flat $3$--manifolds, called $X$--ADM mass and we establish a relative positive mass theorem via a monotonicity formula along the level sets of a suitable Green's function. Under different assumptions on $X$, we obtain generalizations of the ``classical'' positive mass theorem, like the one for weighted manifolds and the one ``with charge'' under some topological restrictions. Finally, we also discuss the rigidity cases.
